title: Kissed roasted Brazilian beans Bowl
description: A delicious flexitarian dish featuring refried beans, nimono-simmer, and a hint of Brazilian spices. Perfect for a cozy dinner or romantic evening.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together the refried black beans, diced red bell pepper, and chopped yellow onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the spice blend to the bean mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the beans are baking, prepare the nimono-simmer.
In a medium saucepan, combine the water and Brazilian-style salsa.
Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of the roasted bean mixture on the bottom of a bowl.
Top with a spoonful of the nimono-simmer and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
